RnB Knights

RnB Knights blend old skool and new skool RnB with silky grooves, tight musicianship, and a vibe-packed setlist — perfect for lovers of rhythm, soul, and brass.

About RnB Knights

RnB Knights are a slick, high-energy band delivering the best of both old skool and new skool RnB. From smooth 90s grooves to modern soul bangers, their live sets are filled with feel-good vibes, lush harmonies, and undeniable groove. Available as a trio or expanded 6-piece with full brass, they bring a flexible, crowd-pleasing experience to every event. Fronted by multi-instrumentalist and vocalist Rya — known for BBC Introducing and 70k+ Spotify streams — the band features elite musicians with credits spanning Glastonbury, Wembley, and the Royal Albert Hall, plus performances alongside Ronan Keating, Grace Jones, and more. With a tight, well-rehearsed set and the option to request up to three custom songs, RnB Knights deliver performances that feel personal, fresh, and full of soul. Expect outstanding musicianship, warm communication, and dance floor magic every time. The band comes fully equipped with PA, lighting, and optional DJ sets. RnB Knights — always ready to bring the RnB vibes. Enquire now!
